title: visualize graph
explanation:
### Description

This example visualizes a minimal directed graph with two vertices and two parallel edges using a Simple 2D layout strategy. Uses AddGraphEdge (the Python-accessible method) to create edges.

**dataset → input → layout → filter → visual_asset → renderer → infrastructure → output**

- [vtkGraphLayout](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkGraphLayout.html) applies the layout strategy to the graph.
- [vtkGraphToPolyData](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkGraphToPolyData.html) converts graph edges to polydata lines.
- [vtkMutableDirectedGraph](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkMutableDirectedGraph.html) builds the directed graph.
- [vtkPolyDataMapper](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPolyDataMapper.html) maps edge polydata to graphics primitives.
- [vtkSimple2DLayoutStrategy](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkSimple2DLayoutStrategy.html) arranges vertices in 2D.
